content.title: Hong Kong home prices to rise in 2026 on the back of mainland Chinese buyers, rate cut
content.summary: Hong Kong home prices are likely to see up to a 5 per cent boost in 2026 on the back of mainland Chinese buyers, interest rate cuts and fewer unsold new flats, according to analysts. In addition, the stamp duty adjustment and Hong Kong's resurgent stock market were also expected to help sustain stability in the city's residential property market, according to JLL and Cushman & Wakefield.
